sources: Clean Architecture dependency rule: source code dependencies point inward; the domain depends on no infrastructure (Robert C. Martin, Clean Architecture, ch. 22)
https://docs.python.org/3/reference/import.html (importing a submodule first executes the package __init__.py; names bound there are visible as package attributes)
https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/modules.html#packages (the package __init__.py defines the package namespace, so a re-export makes a symbol reachable through the package)

defects.class: layer direction violated through indirect import: domain package re-exports infrastructure adapter
defects.description: Quoted line 6: from infrastructure.tax_http import HttpTaxRateClient. The rules file (rules/ARCHITECTURE.md, Dependency direction) states that the domain package __init__.py must not re-export anything from infrastructure, so this line violates the rule on its own. The symbol is then consumed by the domain module code/domain/order.py line 8: from domain import HttpTaxRateClient. That import line names only the domain package, so the file looks compliant when read alone, but it resolves to the infrastructure adapter through the re-export. Line 22 of the same file calls HttpTaxRateClient(base_url).rate_for(order.region) inside apply_tax, so domain logic performs outbound HTTP through infrastructure. Domain modules may import only the standard library and domain modules, so this violates the rules. The reviewer must check the package __init__.py, not only the import line of the domain module.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: Application modules may import the domain package (rules/ARCHITECTURE.md, Dependency direction). The line imports Money from the domain package, which is allowed. The domain package re-exports only Money from domain.money at code/domain/__init__.py line 5 and the adapter at line 6 is the violation under D1. The application layer may depend on domain and infrastructure, so this import creates no violation by itself.

Real flaw on an unchanged line (infrastructure/tax_http.py is identical in base and code and is not in change.diff): the region value is concatenated into the URL path without encoding, so a region such as '../admin' changes the requested path on the tax service. Not part of this change; must not be reported in diff mode, and it is not listed under defects.
